archetypes.name: dyn-gatec-persist
archetypes.rationale: Gate C now fails closed on assessment persistence and stale removal.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the new architectural-guidelines persist-design-assessment path and Gate C instructions. Focus on present/absent/invalid source validation, stale artifact removal, tmpdir validation, and whether any approval path can proceed after a persistence failure. Check that the helper behavior matches the documented clean and deviation flows. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: dyn-runlog-audit
archetypes.rationale: The new artifact is consumed by both committed-log audit surfaces.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the audit-runs and fluff-analysis ingestion for architectural-guideline-assessment.md. Focus on manifest-enumerated design runs, clean-vs-deviation classification, zero-finding report reachability, and registry dispatch. Check that malformed or missing artifacts are surfaced without breaking legitimate old runs. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
